text.p: Here are the highlights from Swiss newspapers on Thursday:
- Swiss adverstising spending fell by 0.3 percent in May compared to the prior month.
- Managers in Switzerland earned some 244,000 Swiss francs in 1996, up 24,000 francs from the year before, Swiss journal 'Handelzeitung' wrote.
- Swiss and French troops will organise the largest ever joint excercise this fall in the Savoy Alps.
- Zurich police were officially criticised by a parliamentary investigation committee for their passive role during a skinnhead demonstration in Zurich this past April.
